title: Vinge rolls out Vesence firm-wide
summary: Vinge, one of the leading business law firms in the Nordics, is bringing Vesence to the entire firm, with licences for all employees.
body_markdown:
Customer Cases


November 14, 2026


# Vinge rolls out Vesence firm-wide


Vesence is excited to announce a firm-wide rollout at Vinge, one of the leading business law firms in the Nordics. The rollout will bring Vesence to the entire organisation, with licences for all employees, including both lawyers and business support teams.


Staying at the forefront of AI while maintaining high standards of quality and control is an integral part of Vinge's strategy. This commitment is reflected in the firm's systematic approach to evaluating and testing new AI products.


Vesence brings drafting, review, editing and formatting together in integrated workflows across the Office environment. Vinge's employees can delegate these tasks to coding agents and review the results with tracked changes, retaining control from first draft to final document.


> “Our investment in Vesence is part of our strategy to stay at the forefront of AI and to continuously develop how we work. Rolling it out across the whole firm, to lawyers and business support alike, gives our people more time for the work where experience and judgement create the greatest value for our clients.”


Ann-Marie Carelius Ovin


, CIO, Vinge


Vesence will support Vinge's teams through onboarding and training to get the most out of the platform. The rollout is part of Vinge's ongoing work to continuously refine how it works and further increase precision and efficiency in its client work.


Vesence looks forward to getting started with Vinge.
